note: Harness scope lives here, not in prose. Each entry is a triple: behavior, verification command, state. State machine: not_started -> active -> passing | blocked. 'passing' is irreversible and may only be set by a green verification command. Work on exactly ONE 'active' entry at a time (WIP=1). Entries must be completable in one session inside this repository.

features.behavior: REPLACE ME: state what is observably true when this works
features.verification: the command that proves it, e.g. {{RUN}} test
